findings.problem: A deny rule refuses a cleanup call that is safe in practice, and each refusal is followed by several retried variants.

recommendation.option: Allow the safe variant and delete the stale deny pattern
recommendation.why: It removes the cause and deletes a rule rather than adding one.

findings.situation: The cleanup call of tool-alpha was refused by a deny rule on 22 occasions [E-001.refusals=22], in 6 sessions [E-001.sessions=6] over 4 days [E-001.days=4].
findings.title: Should the safe variant of tool-alpha cleanup be allowed?
findings.why_problem: The rule matches the call by name only, so it cannot tell the safe variant from the dangerous one.

findings.title: Should the expected exit code of tool-beta lint be treated as success?
findings.why_problem: The wrapper maps every nonzero exit code to an error.
